_meta.name: succession-plan
_meta.deskripsi: Succession plan + exit strategy untuk Owner + 5 PIC kritis. Identify successors, ramp-up plan, knowledge transfer. V4.0 - Bab 63.

succession_overview.filosofi: Succession bukan tentang siapa yang replace, tapi tentang continuity bisnis + sustainability knowledge. Plan dibuat sejak awal, bukan saat kritis
succession_overview.scope: Owner (Pak Ardian) + 5 PIC kritis (Mada, Rizal, Riza, Bu Nisya, Yudi/Sdek)
succession_overview.horizon: Jangka pendek (1-2 tahun), menengah (3-5 tahun), panjang (5-10 tahun)

succession_per_role.successor_external: Profesional eksternal dengan track record property (jika tidak ada internal)
knowledge_transfer: Network bank, supplier, subkon, notaris - 1 tahun ramp up
Strategic decision making (approve > Rp 10jt) - 3 tahun supervised decision
Profit sharing calculation + tax planning - 2 tahun deep dive dengan konsultan
succession_per_role.trigger_for_succession: Pak Ardian decide semi-retire, atau health issue, atau ekspansi butuh partner
succession_per_role.exit_strategy: Profit sharing gradual transition, Bu Nisya + Mada buy-in saham secara bertahap, Pak Ardian retain 30% sebagai passive owner

succession_per_role.successor_primary: Novita (admin senior, sudah in-line untuk legal admin)
succession_per_role.successor_external: Konsultan hukum tetap (law firm retainer) untuk cover pekerjaan hukum
succession_per_role.trigger: Bu Nisya cuti panjang, atau resign, atau fokus ke family
succession_per_role.exit_strategy: Hire associate lawyer (in-house) + retain law firm, Novita manage admin + filter

succession_per_role.successor_primary: P1 senior yang di-promote (Reni atau Reta - yang paling capable operasional)
succession_per_role.successor_secondary: Hire eksternal senior operation (10+ tahun experience)
succession_per_role.trigger: Mada promosi ke Co-Director, atau Mada resign, atau ekspansi butuh Mada ke cluster baru
succession_per_role.exit_strategy: Promote 1 P1 senior ke Mada track, 1 P1 lain naik ke P2 (Reni atau Reta). Hire 1 fresh P0/P1 untuk fill the gap

succession_per_role.successor_primary: Amir (proyek lead cover) + Mada (strategic decision backup)
succession_per_role.successor_secondary: Hire eksternal senior site manager (15+ tahun experience, track record proyek property)
knowledge_transfer: Strategic planning + risk proyek - 1 tahun practiced
succession_per_role.trigger: Rizal promosi ke P3 (kepala divisi + saham), atau Rizal resign, atau ekspansi butuh multi-site manager
succession_per_role.exit_strategy: Promote Amir ke P1 senior proyek, hire 1 sub-project manager baru, Mada get 1 arsitek konsultan tetap

knowledge_transfer: Meta Ads + Google Ads - 3 bulan intensive
succession_per_role.trigger: Riza promosi ke P2, atau Riza resign, atau scaling butuh multi-PIC marketing
succession_per_role.exit_strategy: Promote Yudi/Sdek ke P1 senior marketing (jika capable), hire 1 fresh P0 social media

succession_per_role.trigger: Yudi/Sdek promosi ke P2 (jika dia ambassador kuat), atau resign
succession_per_role.exit_strategy: Promote Reta ke P1 closing, hire 1 fresh front desk + sales

struktur_notion.1_sop_dan_prosedur: Semua SOP per divisi, versioned, searchable
struktur_notion.2_decision_log: Log keputusan strategis, why + what + outcome, agar successor bisa lihat pattern
struktur_notion.3_kontak_dan_network: Database bank officer, notaris, supplier, subkon, KOL - siapa PIC, kontak, MoU expiry
struktur_notion.4_lesson_learned: Setiap project selesai: what worked, what didn't, what to do differently
struktur_notion.5_dashboard_history: Screenshot dashboard periodik, untuk trend analysis
struktur_notion.6_personal_knowledge: Setiap PIC punya 'brain dump' area: apa yang hanya dia tahu (tacit knowledge)

knowledge_management_system.cadence: Quarterly review + update, Mada monitor compliance

exit_strategy_per_skenario.transition_plan: Bu Nisya + Mada naik ke Co-Director, profit sharing bergeser, saham gradual buy-in
exit_strategy_per_skenario.komunikasi: Internal announcement Q1, konsumen tetap di-assure continuity

exit_strategy_per_skenario.transition_plan: Promote 1 P1 senior (Reni atau Reta) ke P2 COO Proxy, hire 1 fresh P0 untuk backup
exit_strategy_per_skenario.komunikasi: Internal only, klien/konsumen tidak perlu tahu

exit_strategy_per_skenario.transition_plan: Mada atau Rizal relocate untuk 6-12 bulan, PIC existing handover sementara, hire 5-7 PIC baru di kota baru
exit_strategy_per_skenario.komunikasi: Klien existing di-assure, tim baru di-recruit dari lokal

exit_strategy_per_skenario.transition_plan: Rizal + Mada retrain untuk Komersial, Riza pivot ke higher-ticket marketing, Bu Nisya fokus kontrak premium
Bu Nisya lead legal + due diligence, Mada + Rizal manage operational integration, owner decide struktur partnership

monitoring_dan_review.peserta: Pak Ardian, Bu Nisya, Mada, Rizal, Riza
agenda: Update successor readiness (siapa yang sudah ready, siapa yang perlu ramp up)
Knowledge management compliance (apakah SOP sudah up-to-date)
Risk concentration (apakah ada single point of failure)
Succession bench strength (berapa successor ready untuk setiap role)
monitoring_dan_review.output: Update succession-plan.json, komunikasi ke PIC yang relevan
